la:noun:axis.gloss: An axletree of wagon, car, chariot.
senses: An axletree of wagon, car, chariot.
The heavens or a region or clime of these.
la:noun:axis.html:
axis, is, m.
kindred with Gr. ἄξων; Sanscr. akshas = axle, wheel; old Germ. Ahsa; mod. Germ. Achse; Engl. axle, Bopp, Gloss. p. 2, a; cf. Aufrecht, Zeitschr. für vergl. Sprachf. 8, p. 71
.
Lit., an axletree, about which a round body, e.g. a wheel, turns: faginus axis,: axes aerii,; 7, 33: axis versatilis,—Meton. (pars pro toto), a chariot, car, wagon, ; ; ; —Plur., ; .—
Transf.
The axle of a water-clock, .—
The axis of the earth: mundum versari circum axem caeli, Cic. N. D. 1, 20, 52; so ; ; .—Hence, meton.
The pole, : axis inocciduus,: meridianus,.—
Esp., the north pole, ; ; ; ; ; .—
The whole heavens: maximus Atlas Axem umero torquet stellis ardentibus aptum,; ; ; ; ; 6, 175; ; ; —Hence, sub axe, under the open heaven, ; .—
A region of the heavens, a clime: boreus,the north,: hesperius,the west,; .—
A pin or hook on which a hinge turns, .—
The valve of a pipe, .—
Axes volutarum, in archit., the axes of a volute, .—
A board, plank, ; ; ; ; ; ; —
An unknown wild animal in India, .
